sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have reminded us how you previously held prices steady; it sounds like you want that partnership reciprocated, not merely acknowledged. We value that support and want to recognise your verified cost changes while supporting your cash flow and a predictable transition. How could faster payment help us agree a cost-based adjustment and an effective date that work for both sides?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. Our should-cost estimate for Volute casing HN 50-200 is EUR 132.64 per 1 (cost:310010). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 86% of your invoices late, on average 3 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 3 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €134.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate your transparent approach and your commitment to 14-day payment terms, which we are pleased to accept alongside the 1 January 2027 effective date.
We therefore propose a revised price of €134.50 per unit, reflecting a fair step towards your position while ensuring our continued reliability.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We value our longstanding partnership and want predictable cash flow for you alongside a fair, evidence-based adjustment. How can we also reflect the verified fall in electricity producer prices so the resulting price accounts for relief as well as increases?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 128.04 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have passed on the verified energy savings while stressing that your costing stays private; it seems you want a fair agreement without opening your books. We respect that boundary and value the partnership, including dependable payment from our side. How can we use our established order-price baseline and the verified cost movements to reach a fair close that recognises both your cost pressures and the savings?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Your letter (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +2.0%. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 129.11 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

Thank you for reflecting the verified notice-period data in your revised offer; we appreciate your movement and value our partnership. We would like to review the relevant driver indices together to establish a clear basis for the adjustment, while respecting the confidentiality of your internal calculation. In the same spirit of mutual support, we could consider shorter payment terms in exchange for a lower unit price, and ask you to explore a later effective date.

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Volute casing HN 50-200 is up +10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +2.0%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 129.11 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
